hook.title: Funded Tape
hook.subtitle: Top 5 prop firm stories
hook.say: Funded Tape: the top 5 prop firm stories, October 27 to November 3. Number one: a comparison site loses about 21 partners. Number five: a way to buy back a blown funded account. Let's go.

items.title: Prop Firm Match loses ~21 partners
items.summary: Clicks on firm profiles and codes ran through its affiliate links.
items.say: Number one. Prop Firm Match lost about 21 partner firms after clicks on firm profiles and copy-code buttons were sent through its affiliate links. Apex, Tradeify and Lucid are among them. Prop Firm Match says the impact was a low single-digit share of its commissions, and that prices and codes weren't affected.

items.title: PipFarm scraps its $5,000 payout cap
items.summary: New accounts get a payout cap that keeps rising with no maximum.
items.say: Number two. PipFarm scrapped its $5,000 payout cap for accounts bought from November 1. The cap still starts at 3% and rises 1% with every payout, but now there's no maximum. Older accounts keep their old caps.

items.title: Topstep: heavy account-buyers go Live
items.summary: Cycling through lots of accounts can trigger a move to Live.
bullets: Reply to a trader on X, Oct 28

mock.name: Topstep on X · Oct 28
mock.rest: Repeatedly cycling through accounts will eventually mean proving your strategy in Live.

items.say: Number three. Topstep says traders who keep cycling through accounts will be moved to Live. One trader took four payouts in three weeks before his call-up. In Topstep's words: it isn't a SIM lottery. TopstepX also added Live performance stats.

items.title: GOAT Access: a $50K eval for $39
items.summary: Goat Funded Futures' new one-phase 50K, activation only after you pass.
items.say: Number four. Goat Funded Futures launched GOAT Access, a 50K evaluation for $39, plus a $99 activation only after you pass. It has a 5% target and no daily loss limit. The catch: no news trading, and payouts are capped at $1,500.

items.title: Tradeify launches Funded Reset
items.summary: Buy back a blown Select funded account, no new evaluation.
bullets: 30 days after the breach to buy
Not if that account ever paid out
items.say: Number five. Tradeify's new Funded Reset lets you buy back a blown Select funded account without retaking the evaluation. You get 30 days after the breach, prices start at $450, and it's off-limits if that account ever paid out.

outro.cta: Subscribe to Funded Tape for the weekly Top 5
outro.say: That's the week. Subscribe to Funded Tape for the weekly top five. Not financial advice.
